title: Collapse Hierarchy

solutions.title: One class, kept under the name callers already use
solutions.tradeoff: There is no longer a superclass sitting ready for a second kind of room to specialise from - the next room type that genuinely varies has to reintroduce the split itself, from a single class.

reviewFocus: Does `Room` still exist anywhere in the solution after the collapse?
Which name survived - PracticeRoom or Room - and does the walkthrough justify it by something other than convention, given PracticeRoom is the only one either file ever exported?
Is RoomProps still named RoomProps after the merge, and is that choice discussed rather than just left as a leftover?
Does renderPracticeSchedule's output - line formatting, the total, the empty-schedule message - match byte for byte before and after?
Compare against drill-12-07: does the walkthrough say plainly what makes these two refactorings different, not just that they are?
